latestVersion.changelog:
OpenClaw Workspace Sync Helper 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Guides users to safely and efficiently synchronize cloud OpenClaw workspaces to local computers.
- Supports rsync+inotify, sshfs mounting, and Syncthing, with tailored recommendations based on user needs.
- Generates copy-ready sync commands and safety notes; does not auto-execute any actions.
- Designed for DevOps/development assistance, local editing, real-time sync, and backup scenarios.
